description: Explicit ordering-compilation experiment: existing scalar, scan, bounded sort and computed-sort controls plus full sorting and mixed nullable integer/boolean keys over the unchanged 1000-row fixture. Projection outputs remain integers for every comparison adapter.

workloads.name: sort_limit
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score FROM items ORDER BY score DESC, id LIMIT 20

workloads.name: computed_sort
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score FROM items ORDER BY score * 3 + bucket DESC, id LIMIT 20

workloads.name: plain_scan
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score FROM items ORDER BY id

workloads.name: full_sort
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score FROM items ORDER BY score DESC, id

workloads.name: sort_mixed_nulls
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score FROM items ORDER BY CASE WHEN bucket < 3 THEN NULL ELSE bucket END ASC NULLS FIRST, (score >= 5000) DESC, score DESC, id LIMIT 20
